title: ISO 14001:2015 Transition Training: Environmental Management System
overview: This training program is tailored for managers overseeing environmental and sustainability responsibilities. It provides a structured approach to successfully transitioning to the ISO 14001:2015 standard with any accredited certification body. Participants will explore all the new requirements introduced in the 2015 revision, equipping them to return to their organizations and implement the methodologies covered during the course effectively.

The course highlights how the updated ISO 14001:2015 standard aligns with the organization's strategic direction, emphasizing the enhanced relevance of its clauses. Participants will identify risks and opportunities impacting environmental performance and develop a more focused approach to planning and achieving environmental objectives.

The critical ‘leadership’ clause will be thoroughly explored, enabling participants to engage top executives and secure their commitment to key environmental initiatives. The course also delves into performance evaluation techniques, helping participants assess the effectiveness of their Environmental Management System (EMS) while driving continuous improvement. Additionally, participants will learn to establish an effective compliance framework to manage organizational environmental compliance and regulatory requirements.
audience: This course is ideal for managers and supervisors responsible for ISO Management Systems, including HSEQ managers, environmental managers, quality managers, and others tasked with enhancing environmental performance. Internal auditors auditing environmental compliance and performance will also benefit from this training.
methodology: This interactive course combines presentations, case studies, and technical learning sessions. Industry-specific discussions and implementation challenges enrich the learning experience.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Advise top management on how the ISO 14001:2015 standard impacts the organization.
Develop a framework to manage organizational risks and opportunities effectively.
Establish a system for evaluating compliance and communicating compliance outcomes.
Implement robust document control practices to support ISO 14001 requirements.
Align environmental objectives and targets with the organization’s strategic direction, ensuring continuous evaluation and improvement of environmental performance.
